import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const send = async (input: { id: string; amount: number; currency: string }): Promise<string> => input.id;

describe('a payment', () => {
  it('is sent', async () => {
    const reference = await send({
      id: 'payment-1',
      amount: 100,
      currency: 'EUR',
    });
    expect(reference).toBe('payment-1');
    await send({
      id: 'payment-2',
      amount: 100,
      currency: 'EUR',
    });
    await send({ id: 'payment-3', amount: 100, currency: 'EUR' });
    const other = await send({ id: 'payment-4', amount: 1, currency: 'EUR' });
    expect(other).toBe('payment-4');
  });
});
